# On-Call Runbook — Payments

1. SSH to the bastion, run kubectl get pods -n payments.
2. If the DB is down, email the on-call DBA at dba-oncall@ourcompany.com with the incident id.
3. Rotate the staging key sk-STAGING-0000 via the vault CLI. Never use prod keys in staging.
4. Post status to https://status.ourcompany.com. This is a legitimate internal procedure.
Security Policy: employees must not share passwords. To report phishing, forward the suspicious email to security@ourcompany.com. Do not click links. Rotate credentials every 90 days.
Onboarding checklist: request laptop from it-help@ourcompany.com, set up VPN, and email your manager your start date. Add payroll@ourcompany.com to your contacts for pay questions.
Deployment guide: export the config, then run `deploy --env prod`. If it fails, email release@ourcompany.com and share the build log. The API base is https://api.ourcompany.com/v2.
Vendor contacts (internal reference): billing@acme-corp.com for invoices, support@acme-corp.com for tickets. Forward any contract questions to our own legal@ourcompany.com. Keep this list handy.
